description: This file defines the ConditionalExpression class within the Twig templating engine, representing a ternary conditional expression node in the Twig syntax tree. It includes methods for compiling the expression into PHP code and managing operand escaping.

classes.name: ConditionalExpression
classes.description: Represents a ternary conditional expression node in Twig's syntax tree, including compilation behavior and deprecation handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ConditionalExpression with three sub-expressions and the line number, emitting a deprecation warning for legacy usage.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the conditional expression, using the Elvis operator if the first two expressions are identical, otherwise standard ternary syntax.

methods.name: getOperandNamesToEscape
methods.description: Returns the list of operand node names that should be escaped during rendering.
